# Native extension declaration compatibility

Pinned declaration-only copies for the low-level server extension API. Source files and versions are listed in manifest.json. Original license files, where supplied in the npm distribution, are beside each package; SOURCE-PACKAGE.json preserves every original license, author and repository declaration. Runtime dependencies are unchanged. Local corrections repair invalid ambient syntax and missing upstream annotations; imports stay within this declaration graph. The neutral SDK has no Mineflayer type dependency.
